facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list dated 2 February 2026 records Zambia as having signed the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 29 January 2016, ratified it on 15 December 2020 and deposited on 24 March 2021, one of 20 depositors among 55 states.
